finalText:
**Redis went down and never came back.**

```
02:14:07   redis refused → cache turned off
02:14:10   store overloaded → 5s timeouts start
02:14→02:31 queue depth grew 52 → 568
02:29:12   queue passed its 500 limit
02:31:44   worker-2 ran out of memory
02:31:52   api killed → service down
```

Every read went straight to the store. It could not keep up.

The app retried redis 13 times, all refused at `10.0.0.12:6379`. Retries were a flat 80 seconds apart. There was no backoff.

Worth checking first: why that redis box refused connections.
